plan: My private value is $14. In a second-price auction with three bidders, the optimal strategy is typically to bid my true value. Since the payment is the third-highest bid, I want to ensure I win if the item is worth more to me than that bid. Bidding $14 means I'll win if others bid lower, and I'll only pay less than my value. With no prior history and values drawn independently, a true-value bid seems most rational.

Since the payment will be the third-highest bid, I want to ensure I win if the item is worth more to me than others, but not overpay. I'll bid $34, which exactly matches my private value. This allows me to potentially win if others bid lower, while protecting my potential profit margin.
